name: web-laravel
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: Web app with Laravel
description: Laravel with Eloquent, migrations, queues and Artisan: PHP apps and APIs with everything built in.

base.command: command -v composer >/dev/null || { echo 'Composer is required: https://getcomposer.org' >&2; exit 1; }; composer create-project laravel/laravel {{name}} --no-interaction --prefer-dist --quiet

instructions:
## How to work here

- Generate with Artisan (`php artisan make:model Order -mcr`) instead of creating files by hand.
- Validate with Form Requests and protect routes with middleware and policies.
- After changing the schema: `php artisan migrate`. Before finishing: `php artisan test`.
